description: Literature-informed regional activation scenario selected to reduce the exaggerated split R; model calibration, not patient-specific validation.
change: Twelve ventricular delivery sites across four endocardial regions replace four isolated sites. The LV posterior region moves from upper-mid to inferior paraseptal myocardium, and RV onset is identified as anterior free-wall delivery.
coordinateChoice: Three targets per region at normalized apex-to-base offsets −0.07, 0, +0.07. Their physical offsets are geometry-dependent, not a claim of exact 7 mm spacing or measured Purkinje junctions.
notchMetric: Largest prominence of a secondary positive lead-II QRS maximum in 190–295 ms, detected with 0.015 mV minimum prominence. This is a descriptive comparison, not a diagnostic criterion.
limitations: A residual late shoulder remains. No measured ECG samples, gain fit, or post-hoc waveform filter enter the calculated signal; the anatomical activation scenario was deliberately chosen for a more representative QRS.
